🌳 Cornwallis Road Park

2830 Wade Rd, Durham, NC · Durham

Arrive 3 pm, leave by 5 pm · Free · No sign-up needed

  • First 🌳 Cornwallis Road Park · map · if it’s dry

Add to calendar

Lego Lab @ Southwest at Cornwallis Road Park

Google CalendarOpens Google Calendar with the event filled in, ready to save. Apple, Outlook or another calendarDownloads a calendar file. Open it on an iPhone, Mac or Outlook and tap Add.

Your child runs off energy at the park, then takes on the Lego Lab challenge of the day and builds for the first hour. At 4:30 pm they can help sort blocks.

  • Bring a snack for the park so they go into the library with a full tummy.
  • Let them choose what to build and stay with the challenge as long as they like.
  • Tell them early that the last job is sorting blocks, so leaving feels like part of the game.
